FROM python:3.10-slim

# Install system dependencies per requirements (SSH, Supervisor, net-tools) and utilities
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    unzip \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    wget \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Supervisor
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

# Configure SSH
RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Python dependencies: hard requirements (mcp, numpy) and target tool (simsimd)
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir mcp numpy simsimd

# No restrictive CMD/ENTRYPOINT

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install base tools: Python, pip, git, wget, curl, unzip, plus SSH + supervisor + net-tools
# We combine these to keep the layer clean. 
# Note: 'python-is-python3' is a convenient package in 22.04 to handle symlinks, but manual symlink is also fine.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3 python3-pip git wget curl unzip ca-certificates \
    supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    && update-ca-certificates \
    && ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python \
    && ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Supervisor configuration to manage sshd (nodaemon)
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

# SSHD keepalive configuration
RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

# Prepare SSH runtime dirs, enable root login for debugging, and adjust PAM
RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Mandatory: install MCP client and numpy
RUN pip install mcp numpy

# Fetch tool source (interface repository)
WORKDIR /opt
RUN git clone https://github.com/AnjaliSandip/ElmerFEM-OpenFOAM-Dakota

# No restrictive CMD/ENTRYPOINT; users can start supervisord or sshd as needed
usage_entry_command: which sshd && python3 -c "import numpy, mcp; print('numpy', numpy.__version__)" && test -d /opt/ElmerFEM-OpenFOAM-Dakota && echo "repo cloned"

FROM python:3.11-slim

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Base tools needed for building and fetching source
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    gfortran \
    ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone and build lbfgs (Fortran, CMake-based)
# We build from source because the 'liblbfgs-dev' apt package is a C port (liblbfgs),
# whereas the requested tool (jmbr/lbfgs) is the original Fortran code wrapped with CMake.
RUN git clone https://github.com/jmbr/lbfgs /opt/lbfgs && \
    cd /opt/lbfgs && \
    mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    cmake .. && \
    make -j"$(nproc)" && \
    # Install built artifacts to system locations
    # CMake defaults to static libs unless BUILD_SHARED_LIBS is set, so we check for both.
    if [ -f liblbfgs.a ]; then cp liblbfgs.a /usr/local/lib/; fi && \
    if [ -f liblbfgs.so ]; then cp liblbfgs.so /usr/local/lib/; fi && \
    # The CMakeLists.txt generates fc.h in the source directory via FortranCInterface_HEADER

# Install system dependencies including SSH, Supervisor, net-tools, and optional GDAL libs for geopandas
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    unzip \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    git \
    wget \
    gdal-bin \
    libgdal-dev \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Supervisor and SSH (equivalent to required snippet)
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    ssh-keygen -A

# Install Python dependencies
# Required: mcp and numpy; Tool: buildingregulariser (+ geopandas runtime deps)
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir mcp numpy geopandas buildingregulariser

# Expose SSH port
EXPOSE 22

# Start Supervisor
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
usage_entry_command: python -c "import buildingregulariser; print('Building Regulariser import OK')" && python -c "import numpy as np; print('NumPy version:', np.__version__)" && python -c "import geopandas as gpd; print('GeoPandas version:', gpd.__version__)" && pip show mcp && pip show buildingregulariser && sshd -T | head

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET (kept exactly and made functional)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \

[supervisord]

[program:sshd]

ClientAliveCountMax 3

    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Additional dependencies for building LEADD and its Python bindings
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libboost-all-dev \
    librdkit-dev \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    libhdf5-dev \
    python3 \
    python3-dev \
    python3-pip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure `pip` command exists (snippet uses `pip`, Ubuntu provides pip3)
RUN ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip

# REQUIRED: install mcp and numpy
RUN pip install mcp numpy

# Clone and build LEADD (pull pybind11 via submodule)
RUN git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/UAMCAntwerpen/LEADD.git /opt/LEADD
WORKDIR /opt/LEADD

# Configure and build; explicitly point CMake to system RDKit
RUN mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    cmake -DRDKit_INCLUDE_DIRS=/usr/include/rdkit \
          -DRDKit_LIBRARY_DIRS=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu \
          -DBUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS=ON \
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
          .. && \
    make -j"$(nproc)" && \
    make install && \
    make clean

# Make Python find the built bindings and expose binaries
ENV PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:/opt/LEADD/lib"
ENV PATH="${PATH}:/opt/LEADD/bin"

# Optional: default to running supervisord with sshd managed
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

# Base tools: Python, pip, git, wget, ca-certificates, and PyMOL
# Note: curl, unzip, supervisor, net-tools, openssh-server are installed in the required snippet below.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3 python3-pip python-is-python3 \
    git wget ca-certificates \
    pymol && \
    ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# System dependencies
# Hard requirements: curl, unzip, supervisor, net-tools, openssh-server
# Build/runtime for AUTOSURF: python3, pip, git, wget, build-essential, gfortran, mpich, libmpich-dev, lapack/blas

pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

    find SOURCE -name Makefile -exec sed -i 's/-O3/-O3 -fallow-argument-mismatch/g' {} + || true

RUN set -e; \
    if find SOURCE -name Makefile | grep -q .; then \
      set -x; \
      for dir in $(find SOURCE -name Makefile -exec dirname {} \; | sort -u); do \
        echo "Building in $dir"; \
        make -C "$dir" || echo "Build failed in $dir, continuing"; \
      done; \
    else \
      echo "No Makefiles found under SOURCE"; \
    fi

# Expose SSH
EXPOSE 22

CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'

nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy

# We set this environment variable to allow pip to install packages into the system python,
# which is required for QGIS (which uses system python) to see them.
ENV PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1

# We also install python3-rtree and python3-geopandas dependencies via apt where possible
# to provide system libraries, though we will upgrade them via pip for MovingPandas.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates gnupg curl wget git \
    python3 python3-pip python3-venv locales \
    unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    libgl1 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure python/pip are available as 'python' and 'pip'
RUN ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python && ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip

# Add QGIS APT repository and install QGIS
# We install the main 'qgis' package to ensure all Processing tools are available.
RUN mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings && \
    curl -fsSL https://download.qgis.org/downloads/qgis-archive-keyring.gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/qgis-archive-keyring.gpg && \
    echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/qgis-archive-keyring.gpg] https://qgis.org/debian bookworm main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/qgis.list && \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qgis && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF' 
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \

    sed -i "s/'pyMKL',//g" setup.py && \
    sed -i "s/'progressbar2==3.37.1'/'progressbar2'/g" setup.py || true && \
    (grep -rl "from collections import Iterable" . | xargs -r sed -i 's/from collections import Iterable/from collections.abc import Iterable/g' || true) && \
    (grep -rl "from collections import Mapping" . | xargs -r sed -i 's/from collections import Mapping/from collections.abc import Mapping/g' || true) && \

pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \

RUN git clone https://github.com/steventopper/TransRot && \
    cd TransRot && \
    mkdir -p bin && \
    find src -name "*.java" > sources.txt && \
    javac -source 17 -target 17 -cp /usr/share/java/commons-math3.jar:/usr/share/java/commons-lang3.jar -d bin @sources.txt && \
    rm sources.txt

# Create a wrapper to run TransRot's main class with proper classpath
RUN cd /opt/TransRot && \
    MAIN_FILE=$(grep -l "public static void main" $(find src -name "*.java") | head -n 1) && \
    PACKAGE=$(grep "^package" "$MAIN_FILE" | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/;//') && \
    CLASS_NAME=$(basename "$MAIN_FILE" .java) && \
    if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then FULL_CLASS="$PACKAGE.$CLASS_NAME"; else FULL_CLASS="$CLASS_NAME"; fi; \
    echo "#!/bin/bash" > /usr/local/bin/transrot && \
    echo "java -cp /opt/TransRot/bin:/usr/share/java/commons-math3.jar:/usr/share/java/commons-lang3.jar $FULL_CLASS \"\$@\"" >> /usr/local/bin/transrot && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/transrot

# Default supervision to keep sshd running
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

RUN mkdir -p /opt/FASSO/diamond && \
    wget -O /tmp/diamond.tar.gz https://github.com/bbuchfink/diamond/releases/latest/download/diamond-linux64.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf /tmp/diamond.tar.gz -C /opt/FASSO/diamond && \
    rm -f /tmp/diamond.tar.gz

    wget -O /tmp/foldseek.tar.gz https://github.com/steineggerlab/foldseek/releases/latest/download/foldseek-linux-avx2.tar.gz && \

WORKDIR /opt/sap-bare-protein
RUN git clone https://github.com/bresmegroup/SAP_bare-protein . && \
    mkdir -p bin && \
    # Compile .f files, ignoring failures (e.g. misnamed shell scripts like count-line.f)
    # Use -mcmodel=large to handle large static arrays common in older Fortran scientific code
    sh -c 'for f in *.f; do \
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue; \
      echo "Compiling $f ..."; \
      gfortran -std=legacy -O2 -mcmodel=large "$f" -o "bin/$(basename "$f" .f)" || echo "Skipping $f (failed to compile)"; \
    done' && \
    # Copy shell scripts to bin
    sh -c 'if ls *.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then cp *.sh bin/; fi' && \
    chmod +x bin/*

CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

    cmake -S /tmp/kokkos -B /tmp/kokkos/build \
      -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/opt/kokkos \
      -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 \
      -DKokkos_ENABLE_OPENMP=ON \
      -DKokkos_ENABLE_MPI=ON \
      -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=mpicc \
      -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=mpicxx \
      -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && \
    cmake --build /tmp/kokkos/build -j$(nproc) && \
    cmake --install /tmp/kokkos/build && \

      -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local \
      -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="/opt/cabana;/opt/kokkos" \
      -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=mpicc \
      -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=mpicxx \
      -DREQUIRE_HOST=ON \

      -DINPUT_DECK=decks/2stream-short.cxx \

    cmake --install /opt/CabanaPIC/build

ClientAliveInterval 60

RUN git clone https://github.com/slcs-jsc/mptrac.git && \
    cd mptrac/src && \
    # Adjust Makefile for Ubuntu paths.
    # Ubuntu's libhdf5-dev puts headers in /usr/include/hdf5/serial and libs in /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/hdf5/serial.
    # We append these paths to ensure the compiler finds hdf5.h if included directly.
    sed -i 's|^INCDIR *=.*|INCDIR = -I/usr/include -I/usr/include/hdf5/serial|g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's|^LIBDIR *=.*|LIBDIR = -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/hdf5/serial|g' Makefile && \
    make -j"$(nproc)"

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# - Required: curl, unzip, supervisor, net-tools, openssh-server
# - Added for RDKit: libxrender1, libxext6, libgl1
# - Added for build reliability: wget, git, build-essential

    curl \
    unzip \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    wget \
    git \
    build-essential \
    libxrender1 \
    libxext6 \
    libgl1 \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Supervisor and SSH (matches required snippet semantics)
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Hard requirement: pip install mcp numpy
# Note: This installs the latest numpy (likely 2.x), which we will downgrade later for ODDT compatibility.
RUN pip install mcp numpy

# Install ODDT dependencies and ODDT itself

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir \
    "numpy<2.0.0" \
    six \
    pandas \
    scipy \
    scikit-learn \
    joblib \
    rdkit \
    --upgrade && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir --no-build-isolation oddt

# Verify installation
RUN python -c "import oddt; print(f'ODDT version: {oddt.__version__}')" && \
    python -c "import rdkit; print(f'RDKit version: {rdkit.__version__}')" && \
    python -c "import mcp, numpy as np; print(f'MCP ok, NumPy {np.__version__}')"

EXPOSE 22
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord"]
usage_entry_command: python -c "import oddt; print(oddt.__version__)" && python -c "import rdkit; print(rdkit.__version__)" && which oddt_cli

logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log

[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \

    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

# Build and install GROMACS 4.5.7 to /usr/local/gromacs
# Inject tirpc include path to satisfy <rpc/rpc.h> references during build
RUN mkdir -p /opt/src && \
    cd /opt/src && \
    wget -q https://ftp.gromacs.org/pub/gromacs/gromacs-4.5.7.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf gromacs-4.5.7.tar.gz && \
    cd gromacs-4.5.7 && \
    mkdir build && cd build && \
    cmake .. \
        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local/gromacs \
        -DGMX_FFT=fftw3 \
        -DGMX_X11=OFF \
        -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-I/usr/include/tirpc" \
        -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-I/usr/include/tirpc" && \
    make -j"$(nproc)" && \
    make install && \
    (test -d /usr/local/gromacs/lib64 && ln -s /usr/local/gromacs/lib64 /usr/local/gromacs/lib || true) && \

FROM ubuntu:22.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Base utilities, Python/pip, build tools
# We include both mono-complete (for legacy .NET Framework) and dotnet-sdk-6.0 (for modern .NET)
# to ensure we can build the solution regardless of its target framework.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3 python3-pip python3-venv \
    git wget curl unzip \
    build-essential \
    mono-complete fsharp nuget \
    dotnet-sdk-6.0 \
    supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    ca-certificates \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip && \
    ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Supervisord config for sshd (Equivalent to REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET)
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

# SSH Configuration
RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Hard requirements: mcp and numpy
RUN pip install mcp numpy

# Clone and Build SlicStan
# We attempt both dotnet CLI and Mono/MSBuild to cover different project types.
# We use '|| true' to allow one method to fail if the other succeeds.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mgorinova/SlicStan /opt/SlicStan && \
    cd /opt/SlicStan && \
    echo "Attempting Dotnet Build..." && \
    (dotnet restore || true) && \
    (dotnet build -c Release || true) && \
    echo "Attempting Mono Build..." && \
    (nuget restore SlicStan.sln || true) && \
    (msbuild SlicStan.sln /p:Configuration=Release || true)

# Verify build success immediately
RUN if [ -z "$(find /opt/SlicStan -type f \( -name 'SlicStan.exe' -o -name 'SlicStan.dll' \))" ]; then \
        echo "Error: SlicStan binary not found after build attempts." >&2; \
        exit 1; \
    else \
        echo "Build successful. Found binary."; \
    fi

# Create wrapper script
# Detects if the artifact is a DLL (Modern .NET) or EXE (Mono/Framework) and runs accordingly
RUN printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -e\nBIN=$(find /opt/SlicStan -type f \( -name "SlicStan.exe" -o -name "SlicStan.dll" \) | head -n1)\nif [ -z "$BIN" ]; then\n  echo "SlicStan binary not found." >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\nif [ "$1" = "--wrapper-version" ]; then\n  echo "slicstan wrapper ok: $BIN"\n  exit 0\nfi\nif [[ "$BIN" == *.dll ]]; then\n  exec dotnet "$BIN" "$@"\nelse\n  exec mono "$BIN" "$@"\nfi\n' > /usr/local/bin/slicstan && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/slicstan

# No restrictive CMD/ENTRYPOINT
usage_entry_command: which slicstan && slicstan --wrapper-version && python -c "import numpy, mcp; print('numpy:', numpy.__version__); print('mcp import ok')"

      make || true; \

        gfortran -O2 -c "$f" || echo "Warning: failed to compile $f"; \
      done; \

    # Identify the executable (name varies by model) \

    for n in std-data-stream babelstream; do \
      if [ -x "$n" ]; then exe="$n"; break; fi; \
    done; \
    if [ -z "$exe" ]; then \
      exe=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable -name "*-stream" -o -name "babelstream" | head -n1); \

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install build dependencies (git, compilers)
# Note: We do NOT install python3/pip via apt to avoid breaking the base image's Conda environment
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    build-essential \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

# Install CMake (>=3.20 required) and Ninja via pip
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir cmake ninja

# Clone repository with submodules (OptiX headers are in third_party)
WORKDIR /app
RUN git clone --recursive https://github.com/xbillowy/diff-surfel-tracing.git

# Build and install
WORKDIR /app/diff-surfel-tracing
# Point to the bundled OptiX headers
ENV OPTIX_HOME=/app/diff-surfel-tracing/third_party/optix

# Export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH so CMake can find Torch's config
# We use the base image's python (Conda) to build
RUN export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$(python -c 'import torch; print(torch.utils.cmake_prefix_path)') && \
    pip install -v .

# Verify installation
# IMPORTANT: Change directory out of source tree to avoid ImportError due to name conflict
WORKDIR /app
RUN python -c "import diff_surfel_tracing; print('diff_surfel_tracing imported successfully')"
usage_entry_command: python -c "import diff_surfel_tracing; print('diff_surfel_tracing import OK:', diff_surfel_tracing.__file__)" && pip show diff_surfel_tracing && python -c "import os, site; p=os.path.join(site.getsitepackages()[0],'diff_surfel_tracing','ptx'); print('PTX files:', os.listdir(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 'ptx dir missing')"

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# 允许在 Ubuntu 24.04+ 上使用 pip 安装系统包 (PEP 668)
ENV PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1

# Base tools: python, pip, curl, wget, git, pkg-config, compilers
# Install petsc-dev via package manager (includes headers, libs, and dependencies like MPI/BLAS/LAPACK)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3 python3-pip python-is-python3 \
    curl wget git pkg-config ca-certificates \
    build-essential gfortran \
    petsc-dev \
 && ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

EXPOSE 22
usage_entry_command: (pkg-config --exists PETSc || pkg-config --exists petsc) && python -c "import numpy; print(numpy.__version__)" && sshd -t

    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \

    echo "root:root" | chpasswd

# We install numpy here to satisfy the snippet, but it will likely be updated/downgraded by the TF install below.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir mcp numpy

# 3) DM3Loc runtime deps: TF2 (with compat.v1), common scientific libraries
# Pin numpy<2 to satisfy TF 2.15 requirements (TF 2.15 supports numpy < 2.0).
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade "numpy<2" tensorflow==2.15.0 scikit-learn pandas biopython h5py

# 4) Fetch DM3Loc source
RUN git clone https://github.com/duolinwang/DM3Loc /opt/DM3Loc

# 5) Patch TF1/Keras-style imports to TF2 compat.v1
# This addresses:
# - 'import tensorflow as tf' -> compat.v1 with v2 behavior disabled
# - 'from keras...' -> 'from tensorflow.compat.v1.keras...'
# - 'import keras' -> 'import tensorflow.compat.v1.keras'
# - Specific fix for 'keras.backend.tensorflow_backend' which was removed in TF2/Keras2.x
RUN sed -i -E "s/import[[:space:]]+tensorflow[[:space:]]+as[[:space:]]+tf/import tensorflow.compat.v1 as tf; tf.disable_v2_behavior()/g" /opt/DM3Loc/*.py && \
    sed -i -E "s/from[[:space:]]+keras\./from tensorflow.compat.v1.keras./g" /opt/DM3Loc/*.py && \
    sed -i -E "s/import[[:space:]]+keras/import tensorflow.compat.v1.keras as keras/g" /opt/DM3Loc/*.py && \
    sed -i -E "s/from[[:space:]]+tensorflow\.compat\.v1\.keras\.backend\.tensorflow_backend[[:space:]]+import[[:space:]]+set_session/from tensorflow.compat.v1.keras.backend import set_session/g" /opt/DM3Loc/*.py && \

RUN set -e; \
    mkdir -p /opt/mzdock; \
    tmpdeb=/tmp/MzDOCKubuntu.deb; \
    echo "Trying to download MzDOCKubuntu.deb (Linux)..."; \
    if curl -L -f -o "$tmpdeb" "https://sourceforge.net/projects/mzdock/files/MzDOCKubuntu.deb/download"; then \
      echo "Downloaded specific deb link."; \
    else \
      echo "Specific deb link failed, trying 'latest'..."; \
      curl -L -f -o "$tmpdeb" "https://sourceforge.net/projects/mzdock/files/latest/download" || true; \
    fi; \
    echo "Downloaded file type:"; \
    file "$tmpdeb" || true; \

      echo "Warning: downloaded artifact is not a Debian package; skipping extraction."; \

 && cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'

logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]

EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd /var/log/supervisor && \

    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# mcp requires Python >= 3.10 (satisfied by 3.11 image)
# cvxpy is a dependency of dmcp; pinning <2 ensures compatibility with older dmcp code if needed

# Install dmcp from source
# Note: dmcp's setup.py contains 'use_2to3=True', which is removed in setuptools >= 58.

    cd /tmp/dmcp && \
    sed -i '/use_2to3=True/d' setup.py && \
    pip install . && \

    curl \

    openmpi-bin \
    pybind11-dev \
    libhdf5-dev \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure pip command is available
RUN ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip

# Python packages (include required mcp and numpy)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir mcp numpy mpi4py h5py

# Fetch Runko source
WORKDIR /app
RUN git clone --recursive https://github.com/hel-astro-lab/runko runko
WORKDIR /app/runko
RUN git submodule update --init --recursive || true
# Fallback: ensure corgi subtree exists if recursive clone didn't populate
RUN if [ ! -d "external/corgi" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A external/corgi 2>/dev/null)" ]; then \
      mkdir -p external && \
      git clone --recursive https://github.com/natj/corgi external/corgi; \
    fi

# Remove architecture-specific flags for portability
RUN sed -i 's/-march=znver3//g' CMakeLists.txt && \
    sed -i 's/-mtune=znver3//g' CMakeLists.txt && \
    sed -i 's/-march=native//g' CMakeLists.txt

# We explicitly build pycorgi because pyrunko depends on it at runtime
RUN mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    export CXX=mpic++ && \
    export CC=mpicc && \
    cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && \
    cmake --build . --target pycorgi pyrunko -j"$(nproc)"

# Make both modules importable
# pyrunko outputs to /app/runko/lib (via CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
# pycorgi might output there too, or to its own submodule lib dir, so we add both.
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app/runko/lib:/app/runko/external/corgi/lib:${PYTHONPATH}"

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

EXPOSE 22

    python3 \

    git \

    ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# This allows 'pip install' to work system-wide without --break-system-packages
RUN rm -f /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/EXTERNALLY-MANAGED /usr/lib/python3.*/EXTERNALLY-MANAGED || true

# 3. Create convenience symlinks for python, pip, and julia
# Linking julia to /usr/bin ensures it is found even if PATH is reset in login shells (fixing Attempt 3 failure)
RUN ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python && \
    ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip && \
    ln -sf $(which julia) /usr/bin/julia

# 4. REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET
# Installs ssh/supervisor/mcp/numpy and configures them
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'

ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy

    curl \

    $VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python -m ensurepip --upgrade

# Fix PATH/Environment for login shells (bash -l)
# 1. Symlink pip: The venv pip script has an absolute shebang, so it works via symlink.
# 2. Wrapper for python: Symlinking the python binary directly breaks venv resolution 
#    (because it resolves to system python which doesn't see the venv's pyvenv.cfg).

RUN ln -sf "$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/pip" /usr/local/bin/pip && \
    echo '#!/bin/sh' > /usr/local/bin/python && \
    echo 'exec /opt/venv/bin/python "$@"' >> /usr/local/bin/python && \

    python3 \

pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log

# - build-essential, git, pkg-config, ca-certificates for building
# - wget, curl, unzip for fetching artifacts
# - Boost dev libs per README (program_options, regex, system, filesystem)

    git build-essential pkg-config ca-certificates make \
    wget curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    libboost-program-options-dev libboost-regex-dev libboost-system-dev libboost-filesystem-dev \
    libgomp1 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy

# Get source
RUN git clone https://github.com/sdaberdaku/PPIprediction /opt/PPIprediction

# Provide a global pre-include header to satisfy older code using unqualified STL symbols
# (covers set/vector/map/algorithm/functional/numeric/string), avoiding intrusive edits in repo.
# This effectively forces 'using namespace std;' and required includes into every compilation unit.
RUN printf '#pragma once\n#include <set>\n#include <vector>\n#include <map>\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <functional>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <string>\nusing namespace std;\n' > /opt/ppipred_prehdr.hpp

# Build 'train'
WORKDIR /opt/PPIprediction/interface_descriptors_train
# Adjust Makefile for portability and successful linking in containers:
# 1. Remove -m64 (arch-specific)
# 2. Remove -static (static glibc/boost not available in slim)
# 3. Remove -march=native (avoids SIGILL on other CPUs)
# 4. Inject -include /opt/ppipred_prehdr.hpp into GPPOPT to fix missing std:: qualifiers globally
RUN sed -i 's/g++ -m64/g++/g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's/-static //g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's/-march=native //g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's/^GPPOPT := /GPPOPT := -include \/opt\/ppipred_prehdr.hpp /' Makefile && \
    make -j"$(nproc)"

    sed -i 's/-static //g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's/-march=native //g' Makefile && \
    sed -i 's/^GPPOPT := /GPPOPT := -include \/opt\/ppipred_prehdr.hpp /' Makefile && \
    make -j"$(nproc)"

# Install binaries to PATH for easy use
RUN cp /opt/PPIprediction/interface_descriptors_train/bin/train /usr/local/bin/ && \
    cp /opt/PPIprediction/interface_descriptors_test/bin/test /usr/local/bin/

ENV PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"

# Keep sshd running under supervisord by default
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord"]

    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

ENV DART_ROOT=/opt/DART

# 4. Configure mkmf.template

# We include -ffree-line-length-none and -Wno-error to handle DART source characteristics and potential strict compiler defaults.
RUN mkdir -p /opt/DART/mkmf /opt/DART/build_templates && \
    cat > /opt/DART/mkmf/mkmf.template << 'EOF'
MPIFC = mpif90
MPILD = mpif90
FC    = gfortran
LD    = gfortran
CC    = gcc
# NetCDF headers/modules: Ubuntu puts them in /usr/include or specific module dirs
INCS  = -I/usr/include -I/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/gfortran/modules
# Link libraries (NetCDF C and Fortran)

FFLAGS = -O2 -ffree-line-length-none -Wno-line-truncation -Wno-error

# Default shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# 1. Pre-requisites: System tools, Python, compilers
# Debian 12 (Bookworm) enforces PEP 668. We remove EXTERNALLY-MANAGED to allow pip installs.
# We install python3-dev to ensure PyCall can link against libpython.

    && ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/bin/pip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# 2. Fix Julia PATH for login shells (bash -l)
# Ensure 'julia' is found regardless of shell PATH behavior.
RUN ln -s /usr/local/julia/bin/julia /usr/local/bin/julia

# 3. Required SSH/MCP Snippet
# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

# 4. Install specific Python dependencies for CalibrateEmulateSample.jl
# Docs specify: For Python 3.11+, use scipy=1.14.1, scikit-learn=1.5.1

    pip install --no-cache-dir scipy==1.14.1 scikit-learn==1.5.1

# Ensure we have root privileges to install packages (scientific images often default to a non-root user)
USER root

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# Allow pip to install into system python even on newer Debian/Ubuntu versions (PEP 668)
ENV PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1

# Install system tools and ensure python3/pip are available
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates \
      software-properties-common \
      wget \
      git \
      python3 \
      python3-pip && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure 'pip' command maps to pip3 so the snippet works as expected
RUN ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy
# ===== END REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/pentilm/FEniCS4EM /root/FEniCS4EM

WORKDIR /root/FEniCS4EM
usage_entry_command: python3 -c "import dolfin; print(dolfin.__version__)" && pip show mcp && python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.version)" && which sshd

FROM python:3.8-slim

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET (equivalent implementation)
# Installing system dependencies including those for SSH, Supervisor, and build tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl wget unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    git build-essential ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Supervisor configuration
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

# SSH configuration
RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Python packages: meet hard requirements and repo versions
# Note: 'mcp' installation is guarded because it may not be available for Python 3.8 on PyPI,
# but the command is required by the task constraints.
RUN pip install --upgrade pip && \
    pip install numpy==1.19.5 && \
    (pip install mcp || echo "Warning: mcp package not found or incompatible, skipping...")

# PyTorch 1.10.2 CPU per README (conda version mapped to pip CPU wheel)
RUN pip install torch==1.10.2+cpu -f https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch_stable.html

# Repo dependencies (pin versions to README)
# Note: tape_proteins is used as package name to match README usage, pip normalizes names so tape-proteins/tape_proteins work.
RUN pip install pandas==1.3.5 tape_proteins==0.5 sequence-models==1.2.0

# Clone repository and fetch landscapes
WORKDIR /app
RUN git clone https://github.com/HeliXonProtein/proximal-exploration.git
WORKDIR /app/proximal-exploration

# Run download script, allow failure to prevent build break on network issues
RUN bash download_landscape.sh || echo "Warning: Landscape download failed, proceeding with build..."

# SSH Port
EXPOSE 22

# Start supervisor
CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]

FROM julia:1.12

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Set PATH for the build process (non-login shell) to prioritize venv and Julia
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/julia/bin:${PATH}"

# Install dependencies
# debianutils is included to ensure 'which' is available for the symlink step
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3 python3-pip python3-venv \
    wget curl git unzip \
    supervisor net-tools openssh-server \
    debianutils \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create venv and upgrade pip
RUN python3 -m venv /opt/venv && \
    /opt/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Persist PATH for login shells (bash -l) to fix verification failures
# This ensures that 'julia' and 'python' are found even if the shell resets PATH
RUN echo 'export PATH="/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/julia/bin:$PATH"' >> /etc/profile && \
    echo 'export PATH="/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/julia/bin:$PATH"' >> /etc/bash.bashrc

# Create symlinks for robustness (ensure binaries are in /usr/bin as a fallback)
RUN ln -sf /opt/venv/bin/python /usr/bin/python && \
    ln -sf /opt/venv/bin/pip /usr/bin/pip && \
    ln -sf $(which julia) /usr/bin/julia

# ===== BEGIN REQUIRED_SSH_MCP_SNIPPET =====
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip supervisor net-tools openssh-server --no-install-recommends && \
    cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

RUN pip install mcp numpy

import site, sysconfig, os
paths = []
try:
    paths += site.getsitepackages()
except Exception:
    pass

         "nodaemon=true\n" \
         "logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log\n" \
         "pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log\n\n" \
         "[program:sshd]\n" \
         "command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D\n" \
         "autorestart=true\n" \
         "startretries=3\n" \
         "stdout_logfile=/var/log/supervisor/sshd-stdout.log\n" \
